name: Workspace and multi-repo registry
description: Operators frequently work across multiple repos (e.g., LiveCalc and FADE). FADE is currently repo-local, making cross-repo coordination, shared standards, shared learnings, and dashboards difficult. This PRD introduces a workspace concept with a repo registry and shared intelligence.

userStories.title: Create and manage a workspace with multiple repos
userStories.description: A workspace contains a registry of repos and shared knowledge/standards.
acceptanceCriteria: Command `fade workspace init` creates a workspace folder (e.g., `~/.fade/workspaces/<name>/`).
Command `fade repo add <path>` registers a repo with name and path; stored in `workspace.json`.
Command `fade repo list` shows registered repos.
Command `fade --repo <name> status|run|metrics` targets a specific registered repo without cd-ing into it (optional but strongly preferred).

userStories.title: Share standards and intelligence across repos with inheritance
userStories.description: Workspace-level standards and learnings can be inherited by each repo while allowing repo overrides.
acceptanceCriteria: Workspace contains `standards/` and `learned.json` (or `learned.md` + json) at workspace level.
When running inside a repo, FADE loads workspace standards first then repo standards, with clear precedence rules.
FADE records key learnings at both repo level and workspace level (configurable).
